title: T-1 KV facade module is the sole reader of the KV binding grep-verified on the applied fixture tree
iWant: the KV binding reference (env.CACHE) to appear in exactly one source module (src/kv-facade.mjs)
soThat: the vendor surface is diffused across zero call sites outside the facade, and a future adapter swap lands without moving any AC

acceptanceCriteria.description: A grep for env.CACHE in the applied fixture src/ tree returns exactly one file: src/kv-facade.mjs. No other module dereferences the raw KV binding. The public surface of src/kv-facade.mjs exports the createKvFacade factory only; the raw env.CACHE reference never crosses the module boundary.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the applied project source tree after apply
acceptanceCriteria.when: grep -rn env.CACHE walks the src/ tree
acceptanceCriteria.then: the search returns one file src/kv-facade.mjs and no other match
